Container.Name: openai-tunnel-client
Container.Overview: Official OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel client, pinned v0.0.18. Outbound HTTPS to OpenAI; no published ports. Shares the running mcp-connectivity-test container's network so http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp works without exposing the server. Start the MCP container first. Fill in your existing tunnel ID, and prepare the single runtime API-key file before applying. Runs as 65532:65532 with read-only storage and dropped capabilities. Admin UI stays on loopback inside the shared namespace. No Cloudflare mode is enabled. See docs/tunnel-client-unraid.md before installation.

Config.Name: Tunnel ID
Config.Description: The complete existing tunnel ID from OpenAI Platform Tunnels. Not an API key. Associate it with the intended ChatGPT workspace separately.

Config.Name: Private MCP URL
Config.Description: Default uses shared network namespace with mcp-connectivity-test. Keep /mcp. If the MCP port was changed inside its container, update this URL. Host published port 8081 is not used here.

Config.Name: Runtime API-key file
Config.Description: Existing single regular file containing your runtime key. Prepare locally with owner 65532:65532 and mode 0400. No key value belongs in this template. Read the setup guide; a missing source can become a directory and fail startup.
